role: AnthropicProvider extension holding request shaping: prompt-cache split of the system prompt, tool declarations (with Anthropic server-side web_search replacing the app's Tavily tool), URLRequest construction, and the SSE line reader.

flags.text: No test exercises AnthropicProvider's request assembly or SSE parsing (grep of EmuquTests finds no call to handle/consumeSSE/spliceLiveState/toolDeclarations/statusError/cacheAwareSystemBlocks; JSONOrderingTests claims to guard provider encoders but only encodes its own Payload struct).

units.does: Splits the composed system prompt at AssistantSystemPrompt.Composed.cacheSplitMarker into a stable prefix (first part) and variable suffix (rest rejoined with the marker), then builds system blocks with only the stable one cache-tagged.

branches.effect: first component; fallback to whole prompt is unreachable since components(separatedBy:) always returns ≥1 element
variable = remaining parts joined by marker; else empty string (single uncached block omitted)

units.does: Builds Anthropic tools[]: custom declarations for every ToolSpec (dropping the app's own web_search when web search is on), appends the server web_search_20250305 tool (max_uses 3, WebSearchService.excludeDomains blocked) when SettingsManager.settingsSnapshot.enableWebSearch, and puts a 1h ephemeral cache breakpoint on the last declaration. Returns nil when there is nothing to send.

branches.cond: tools empty AND web search off

branches.effect: filters out ToolSpec named "web_search" (Anthropic rejects duplicate names); else all tools kept
appends serverWebSearch(maxUses:3, blockedDomains: excludeDomains); else nothing
returns nil (unreachable after guard at 71 unless tools were only web_search and web search off — impossible since filter only applies when on); else last element replaced with cacheTagged copy

flags.text: With web search on, the guard and append at 71/76 add Anthropic's billed server web_search tool (max_uses 3) even when tools is empty. So the toolless 4-arg sends also get it: the summarizer, auto-fact extraction and voice interjection. The comment at AIProvider.swift:543-546 says those sends go out with no tools. They can now trigger paid web searches, and the extra latency runs into their 5 s / 8 s collect timeouts.

units.does: Returns the same ToolDecl with cache_control {type: ephemeral, ttl: 1h}.

branches.effect: rebuilds server web search with cache

units.does: Builds the POST URLRequest: x-api-key, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, anthropic-beta extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11, JSON content-type, SSE accept; body JSON-encoded with .sortedKeys. Throws if encoding fails.
Reads the SSE byte stream line by line: blank line resets the event name, "event:" lines record it, "data:" payloads are passed to handle(); checks task cancellation per line.

branches.effect: loop until stream ends; throws on network error/cancellation
stores trimmed event name and continues

branches.cond: line does not start with data:

branches.effect: skipped; else handle(eventName:data:) which may throw

flags.text: The stream ends whenever bytes end; no check that message_stop arrived. If the connection closes cleanly mid-reply, consumeSSE returns, ProviderStream.run finishes normally and the truncated reply is treated as complete (no .done yielded, no error).
